test_copy.note: VM snapshot retained some unused historical datasets later excluded from final submission. They were not used by the exercised public endpoints. FP32 GPU weights were included but Linux used CPU INT8 weights.

evidence.host_setup_trial: First QEMU launch failed before guest boot due Unicode absolute pflash filename handling. It was archived separately and replaced by relative paths; it is not an application test failure.
